Typography is the craft of making written language legible, readable and appealing.

It is not only a choice of typeface. It is hierarchy, rhythm, and the management of space — the interval between letters, lines and ideas. Read more about rhythm.

A system, not a style

Cormorant carries the display voice; Syne handles the interface; JetBrains Mono marks metadata. Each has one job.

  • Headings balance their lines.
